why: Item 1: none of the verifier's PASS/FAIL conditions requires exact stderr wording, a branch name, a mutation test or a limit on touched files. The exact message ("jsonl-lint: cannot read <file>"), rejecting a second - "before any input is read" and the usage text sit under "Advisory (not pass/fail)". The builder brief's "before reading anything" and "git diff of that file must be empty" are builder instructions, not checks. Check 4 passes if "the lint function is unchanged", matching its line. Check 6 fails only if changes are "split across more than one PR", also matching its line. Item 2: checks 1–3 all run the program ("node BIN a.jsonl b.jsonl c.jsonl", stdin piped with printf, exit-status runs). Only check 4 reads a diff, and line 4 is not a behaviour line.
